sn35.60:0.3: The Full Understanding of All Clinging
sn35.60:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the Dhamma for the full understanding of all clinging.
sn35.60:1.3: “And what, bhikkhus, is the Dhamma for the full understanding of all clinging?
sn35.60:1.4: In dependence on the eye and forms, eye-consciousness arises. The meeting of the three is contact.
sn35.60:1.5: With contact as condition, feeling comes to be.
sn35.60:1.6: Seeing thus, the instructed noble disciple experiences revulsion towards the eye, towards forms, towards eye-consciousness, towards eye-contact, towards feeling.
sn35.60:1.7: Experiencing revulsion, he becomes dispassionate. Through dispassion the mind is liberated. With its deliverance he understands: ‘Clinging has been fully understood by me.’
sn35.60:1.8: “In dependence on the ear and sounds …
sn35.60:1.12: In dependence on the mind and mental phenomena, mind-consciousness arises. The meeting of the three is contact.
sn35.60:1.13: With contact as condition, feeling comes to be.
sn35.60:1.14: Seeing thus, the instructed noble disciple experiences revulsion towards the mind, towards mental phenomena, towards mind-consciousness, towards mind-contact, towards feeling.
sn35.60:1.15: Experiencing revulsion, he becomes dispassionate. Through dispassion the mind is liberated. With its deliverance he understands: ‘Clinging has been fully understood by me.’
sn35.60:1.16: “This, bhikkhus, is the Dhamma for the full understanding of all clinging.”
